choice.basis: The chart title explicitly states 'Stable Revenue of Company C from Q1 to Q4', but the visual data shows an increase from Q1 (≈1100) to Q2 (1400), a plateau from Q2 to Q3 (1400), and a further increase from Q3 to Q4 (≈1600). This contradicts the title's claim of stability. The title is not an authoritative summary of the data, as the visual trend is clearly upward over the period. The 'Route to revenue growth response' is supported by the visual data showing an overall increase from Q1 to Q4 (1100 → 1600). The 'Route to revenue stability response' is refuted because the visual data contradicts the title's claim. The 'Route to finance data maintenance' is not supported by any evidence or condition.
